question: Can I visit your factory?
answer: Yes, we welcome factory visits! Please contact us to schedule an appointment. We'll be happy to show you our production facility and quality control processes.

question: Can you produce with my brand?
answer: Absolutely! We offer OEM and private label services. You can customize packaging with your own brand name and design. Contact our team to discuss your branding requirements.

question: Do you guarantee the quality?
answer: Yes, we guarantee the quality of all our products. Each batch undergoes rigorous quality control and lab testing before shipment. We provide lab reports and certificates with every order.

question: How do you ensure consistent quality?
answer: We maintain strict quality control procedures at every stage of production - from raw material selection to final packaging. Our products are tested for ash content, moisture, fixed carbon, burning time, and caloric value.

question: What are your payment terms?
answer: We accept T/T (Telegraphic Transfer) payment with 50% advance and 50% before shipment. All transactions are in USD.

question: What is the delivery time?
answer: Our standard lead time is 4-6 weeks after order confirmation and receipt of advance payment. This may vary depending on order quantity and current production schedule.

question: How to make an order?
answer: Simply contact us via email at charcoalnesiaglobalexport@gmail.com or WhatsApp at +628212991650. Our team will guide you through the ordering process, from product selection to shipping arrangements.

question: What is your production capacity?
answer: We have a production capacity of 250 tons per month for coconut charcoal products and 135 tons per month for sawdust charcoal. We can scale production based on order requirements.

question: Do you provide free samples?
answer: Yes, we provide free samples for quality evaluation. Contact us to request samples of any product you're interested in. Shipping costs may apply.

question: Can you provide custom packaging?
answer: Yes, we offer custom packaging solutions including private label, custom box designs, and various packaging formats (bulk, full packaging, woven bags).

question: Which countries do you export to?
answer: We export to over 20 countries worldwide including markets in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. Contact us to discuss shipping to your country.

question: Do you provide lab reports?
answer: Yes, we provide complete lab test reports including MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheet) and quality analysis for all our products.

question: Are your products eco-friendly?
answer: Yes, all our charcoal briquettes are made from 100% natural coconut shells and wood - renewable resources. Our products are chemical-free, odorless, and produce minimal smoke and ash.

question: How long is the delivery time for international orders?
answer: International shipping times vary by destination. After production (4-6 weeks), sea freight typically takes 2-6 weeks depending on the destination port. We ship from Jakarta, Semarang, or Surabaya ports.
